attempts.summary: Created an encrypted volume on node1 (AlmaLinux 9) using a 1GB file-backed LUKS2 container (/var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img) unlocked via a root-only keyfile (/etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/srv-secure.key), mapped to /dev/mapper/secure_srv and formatted ext4, mounted at /srv/secure. Configured /etc/crypttab (noauto luks entry) and /etc/fstab (with x-systemd.requires= on the cryptsetup service) so systemd's generated mount unit automatically pulls in decryption and mounts /srv/secure at every boot without any interactive input. Verified end-to-end: rebooted node1 via `systemctl reboot`, confirmed boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just a service bounce), and confirmed /srv/secure was auto-mounted post-boot with the pre-restart test file's SHA-256 checksum unchanged.
